supersedes.reason: That build was published before the last card fix, so its version named a commit that was not the code inside it. Its GitHub release was deleted so a test machine cannot install it; the image tags it produced remain in GHCR but are not referenced here.

recoveredFrom.note: The original branch was left untouched: no force push, no rewrite, no deletion.

notes: edge is not moved: it only follows refs/heads/main.
latest is not moved: it is the stable tag 0.6.0 only, verified after publishing.
A floating vMAJOR.MINOR tag is not created for a prerelease, so a pin cannot silently receive it.
Each digest above was read back from the registry as an OCI image index containing both linux/amd64 and linux/arm64.

windows.note: Downloaded the installer and hashed it locally; the result matches both SHA256SUMS and the asset digest GitHub reports.

signing.evidence: Both the 1.0.15 APK and this 1.0.16 APK were downloaded and their v2 signer certificates extracted; the SHA-256 fingerprints are identical, so an in-place update is accepted.

upgrade.rollbackInvariant: Old and new images read the same schema, so a rollback is a digest swap with no data step.
upgrade.spaceBudgetNote: No new schema objects; three image layers per architecture. The root volume was grown to 45 GiB in the previous round with about 10.65 GiB free after deployment; check df -h / and docker system df before pulling.

pullRequestCi.webE2E: passed on this head, including the flag-off case that failed before this change

notVerified: No live model or external provider was contacted.
No physical Android device install; the user installs it.

ciNote: The artefact commits passed CI twice. Two later empty commits re-ran CI on the identical tree and hit transient infrastructure failures with no assertion ever running: the GitHub releases host returned 504 for both the browser helper and the Electron binary, and a Windows runner had no Visual Studio to build a native module. Those are recorded here rather than hidden; the tree that produced every artefact is documented under source.tip and its CI runs are listed under gates.
